demo.banner: Demo · invented school and students. Your own data is not touched.
home.title: Your classes
home.emptyBody: Add your class and its students. Then make a test and tap through answers for the whole class.
home.privacy: Everything you enter stays on this phone. There is no account and no server that receives it.

class.noTestsBody: Make a test or a rubric to start marking.
class.noStudentsBody: Add your students first: import a list, paste from a spreadsheet, or type names in.

newClass.needGrade: Please write the class or grade.

roster.importBody: Choose a CSV file, or copy the roll number and name columns from a spreadsheet and paste them below.

roster.problem.tooLong: too long to be a name or roll number
roster.keptAnyway: kept, in case two students share a name

roster.leftHint: A student who left keeps their old results but is not shown when you mark new tests.

newTest.keyBody: Questions with answers A to D, or right and wrong.
newTest.rubricBody: Criteria with levels, for reading, writing, speaking or projects.
newTest.examplesNote: These are examples to show how it works, not official curricula or tests.
newTest.notJson: That file is not a template (it should be a .json file).
newTest.name: Name of the test
newTest.subject: Subject
newTest.keyHint: Tap the right answer; it moves to the next question by itself.
newTest.domainHint: A skill you type is copied to the questions below it that have none, so you only type it where it changes.
newTest.rubricHint: You can describe each level later by sharing the rubric as a template file.
newTest.needKeys: Please fill in the answer for every question.
newTest.needCriteria: Please name at least one criterion.
entry.question: Question {q} of {n}
entry.saved: Each tap is saved on this phone as you go.
grid.hint: Tap any box to change it.
grid.caption: Marks for {title}
results.basis: Based on {n} students with every answer marked. {absent} absent and {open} not finished are left out, not counted as zero.
results.noneBody: Results appear when at least one student has every answer marked.
results.commonWrong: A common wrong answer may point to a misunderstanding:
results.groupsNote: Students ranked by score and split into four groups. Equal scores are always in the same group.
results.helpNone: No student is below half in any skill.
progress.averageChart: Line chart of the class average in each test
student.subject: Subject
student.domainsNote: All finished tests in this subject, added up by skill.
report.printHint: In the print screen, choose “Save as PDF” to keep a file or share it.
report.footer: Made with {product} on the teacher's phone.
csv.name: Name
settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: {product} is free and open source. It has no account, no tracking and no server for your data.
backup.title: Back up
backup.body: Make a locked backup file to keep safe or to move to a new phone. Send it to yourself on WhatsApp, or save it to Drive.
backup.passphraseIntro: Choose a passphrase. The file is locked with it, so only someone who knows it can open the file.
backup.warn: Write the passphrase down. Without it the backup cannot be opened, by you or by us.
backup.failed: The backup could not be made. Nothing was changed.
restore.title: Restore or combine
restore.body: Open a backup from this or another phone. Classes already here are updated; other classes are added beside them, so a head teacher can combine several teachers' files.
restore.contains: This backup holds {classes} classes, {students} students and {tests} tests, made on {date}.
restore.mergeNote: Nothing on this phone is deleted. Where both have a mark for the same answer, the newer one is kept.
restore.error.wrong-passphrase: That passphrase does not open this file.
restore.error.not-a-backup: This is not a backup file.
restore.error.newer-version: This backup was made by a newer version. Update the app and try again.
restore.error.damaged: The file seems damaged and could not be read.
pin.title: Locked
pin.forgot: Forgot it? Restore your last backup on a fresh install.
pin.settingsBody: For shared phones: ask for a PIN when the app opens. It keeps others out of the app; it does not encrypt what is stored on the phone.
danger.title: Delete everything
danger.body: Removes every class, student and mark from this phone. Backups you have shared are not affected.
danger.confirm: This cannot be undone. Type {word} to confirm.
onb.welcome: {product} helps you mark tests and see where every student stands. It is free and works without internet.
onb.chooseLanguage: Choose your language · अपनी भाषा चुनें
onb.changeLater: You can change this any time in More.
onb.s1.title: Tap each answer. Kaksha adds it up.
onb.s1.body: Read the student's sheet and tap what they wrote. Right, wrong, totals and percentages are worked out for you.
onb.s2.title: See where every student stands.
onb.s2.body: Which questions were hard, who needs help with what, and how each student is doing across the year.
onb.s3.title: Your class stays on your phone.
onb.s3.body: Names and marks are never uploaded. Make a locked backup file whenever you like, and keep it where you want.
onb.about.title: About you
onb.about.body: This goes on report cards. You can leave your name out.
onb.about.name: Your name (optional)
onb.class.title: Your first class
onb.students.title: Add your students
onb.students.pasteLabel: Paste roll numbers and names, from WhatsApp or a spreadsheet
onb.students.rollBody: Start with roll numbers only. You can add names later, from the class's Students tab.
onb.students.hindiOk: Hindi names work too: आरव, पूजा, …
onb.safe.title: Keep it safe
onb.safe.body: Both are optional. You can change them in More.
onb.safe.pinSub: Ask for a 4-digit PIN when the app opens
onb.safe.reminderSub: A nudge on Today to save a locked copy
onb.ready.title: {cls} is ready.
onb.ready.installBody: It opens like any app and works with no signal. Takes about 2 MB.
onb.ready.installMenu: In your browser's menu, choose “Add to home screen” or “Install app”.
onb.restart: Let's pick up the setup where it makes sense.

today.greet.morning.name: Good morning, {name}
today.greet.afternoon.name: Good afternoon, {name}
today.greet.evening.name: Good evening, {name}
today.saved: Saved on this phone · works offline
today.offline: No signal. Everything still works and saves.
today.tryBody: Everything here is invented. Tap Continue below, then tap a few answers; the app moves to the next student by itself.
today.noTestsBody: Make a test from an answer key or a rubric. It takes about two minutes.
today.backupBody: If this phone is lost, your marks go with it. A backup is one locked file you keep somewhere else.
today.tipBody: Mark one question for the whole class at a time. It is the fastest way through a pile of sheets.
insights.empty: Insights appear once a test has been marked.
insights.satChart: Bar chart: students present, absent and not yet marked in each test
insights.twice: Below half in two tests in a row
insights.twiceNone: No student is below half in their last two tests.
insights.skillsNote: Every fully marked student's marks, added up by skill.
report.optSkills: Strengths and areas to work on
report.optSign: Lines to sign for teacher and parent
reports.allCardsBody: {n} cards, one per page, in one PDF. Choose “Save as PDF” in the print screen.
reports.title: Reports
reports.cardsBody: Every student's card, one per page, in one PDF
reports.summaryBody: Marks and groups for {test} on one page
reports.csvBody: Opens in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice. Hindi names included.
reports.templateBody: Send the latest test to another teacher as a template, without any marks
reports.note: Nothing leaves the phone unless you send it. PDFs are made by the phone's own print, so they work offline.
notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: For example: mixes up cm and m
notes.onCard: Show this note on the report card
notes.privacy: Notes are kept only on this phone, and go into your backups.
student.noNotes: Write what you notice: what helped, what to practise. Only on this phone.
results.histLabel: Bar chart: how many students scored in each band of marks out of {max}
results.hardQs: {qs}: fewer than half got them right.
results.basisShort: Based on {n} students with every answer marked.
results.absentNames: {names} were absent and are left out.
results.qShare: Share of the class that got each question right
results.mixup: When many students pick the same wrong answer, it is often one shared mix-up worth going over with the class.
results.groupsFew: Groups appear once at least four students are fully marked.
progress.change: {now} in the latest test, from {before} in {month}. Attendance {att}.
attendance.title: Who is here?
attendance.body: Tap anyone who was absent. They are left out of class figures, not counted as zero.

dash.downBy: Down {n} points since the test before
common.saveFailed: That did not save: the phone's storage refused it. What you typed is still here. Try again.
save.quota: The phone's storage is full. Free some space, then try again. Earlier marks are safe.
save.blocked: This browser stopped saving. Earlier marks are safe. Try again, or reload the app.
save.other: The phone did not accept them. Earlier marks are safe. Try again.
save.still: Still not saved. Make a backup now so nothing else is at risk, then report the problem.
crash.title: This screen stopped working.
crash.body: Something in the app went wrong, not anything you did.
crash.safe: Marks saved before this are still on this phone.
crash.quotaBody: Free some space (old photos or videos), then try again.
crash.blockedTitle: This browser is not letting the app save.
crash.blockedBody: Private or incognito windows often block saving. Open the app in a normal window.
crash.offlineTitle: This screen needs the internet once.
crash.offlineBody: It has not been saved for offline use yet. Connect, then try again.
del.title: Delete {name}?
del.testBody: This removes the test and its {marks} marks for {students} students.
del.classBody: This removes {students} students, {tests} tests and {marks} marks.
del.undoNote: You can undo this for 12 seconds afterwards.
del.failed: Nothing was deleted: the phone's storage refused. Try again.
undo.failed: Could not undo. Nothing else changed. Try again.
notes.failed: The note did not save. Your text is still here. Try again.
onb.saveFailed: The class did not save, so nothing was created. Your names are still here. Try again.

class.noneAbsent: No student has missed two or more tests.
